historical_reviews.deepseek: The underlying inventory read is relevant, but basic grep does not interpret `|` as alternation without extended mode, `.` is a wildcard and CARD is nonspecific. The returned snippet therefore cannot be trusted as the BMC-card record.

original_test_intent: Verify the FRU identity and service fields of the installed BMC card or management-module assembly, confirm that the record belongs to the active hardware architecture and that BMC Web presents the same card data without disrupting the management path.
original_method: Determine whether management is provided by a removable BMC card or an onboard module, bind the applicable assembly to a stable FRU device, archive the complete inventory, compare card-level fields with the approved hardware/BOM source and confirm the exact Web object while monitoring management continuity.
manual_activity: The platform/BMC owner confirms whether a separate card exists, maps the active management module to its FRU/Web object, provides card-level identity truth and judges any architecture or field mismatch. Automation performs passive evidence collection only.
required_inputs: Management architecture: removable BMC card, DCSCM, onboard BMC or other module
Card/module location, PN/revision/serial and active BMC identity
Stable FRU device/area and exact Web object for the applicable card
Explicit separation between FRU hardware revision and BMC active/staged firmware version
Supported secret-safe BMC session and independent console/management recovery
BMC reachability, SEL/health and log-retention baseline
safety_requirements: Do not use the supplied basic-grep expression as an identity selector
Do not accept a generic CARD match or eight-line excerpt as the full FRU
Confirm that the queried BMC is the same module whose card FRU is being evaluated
Keep hardware FRU and firmware-version evidence distinct
Do not edit FRU, flash firmware, reset BMC, change networking/users or power-cycle the host
Do not clear SEL/dmesg/syslog by default; retain management evidence
Stop on session instability, target mismatch, duplicate/missing card record, BMC health or reachability change
agent_execution_scope: Verify source and management hardware architecture
Record BMC/card identity and independent recovery readiness
Collect the complete raw FRU inventory over approved protected access
Resolve the exact card record by stable device/area rather than regex text
Compare full card-level fields with the approved oracle
Prepare exact Web fields and verify management/SEL/OS health stayed stable
Perform no control, firmware, reset, account/network or verdict action
engineer_actions: Approve card/onboard applicability and active-module identity
Provide the hardware FRU field oracle and firmware-field boundary
Confirm the exact Web object and normalization rules
Resolve management-architecture mismatches and issue the verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The initial `fru print` is a valid passive source, but `grep -iA8 "BMC.CARD|BMC Card|CARD"` is not the claimed alternation in basic grep, treats the dot as any character, is overly broad and truncates the record. It also exposes the password and cannot establish active-module or Web identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe approved BMC access to archive the complete FRU inventory, map the active BMC card/module to a stable FRU device/area, compare all approved hardware fields and correlate the exact Web object without modifying the management controller.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC CARD, `fru list`, readable/correct/Web criteria and 10/10-minute estimates remain; no card architecture, regex match, FRU ID or firmware action is assumed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES MANAGEMENT ARCHITECTURE AND BMC-CARD FRU PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Fingerprint active BMC hardware, confirm separate-card applicability, retain complete FRU records, validate the mapped card's hardware fields against BOM/service truth, verify the Web object and prove uninterrupted management health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces ambiguous text filtering with active-module provenance and separates physical card identity from firmware information.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Any CARD text match can refer to another assembly, while BMC reachability or firmware version does not prove the card FRU. An onboard-BMC platform may make the row not applicable rather than passing it through a chassis FRU.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The read is low impact, but management-target confusion or unapproved BMC reset/configuration could strand the agent; independent recovery and strict read-only scope are essential.

project_override_considerations: If no removable BMC card exists, the engineer must identify the parent/module FRU owning the required fields or declare not applicable. Do not manufacture a card identity from firmware, MAC address or a broad inventory match.
expected_evidence: Exact source/variant and management architecture/applicability statement
Active BMC identity, card/module PN/revision/serial and physical location
Stable FRU device/area and exact BMC-Web object mapping
Approved hardware field/normalization matrix separated from firmware versions
Complete redacted raw FRU inventory and command/session status
Exact mapped card record with false-match analysis for the supplied pattern
Web parity plus before/after BMC reachability, SEL, health and OS logs
No-write/no-reset/no-clear audit, recovery readiness and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently asks for BMC-card FRU data and Web agreement. Card applicability and expected fields are absent, while the derived grep is defective; neither creates a contradiction among the Master Items, Procedure and Criteria.

blocked_analysis.analysis: For a platform with an applicable card or mapped parent module, protected full-inventory collection is well defined. Architecture and field truth are project inputs; absence of a separate card can be handled through an explicit applicability decision.

review_improvement: Corrects the grep semantics, binds the FRU to the active management architecture, separates hardware and firmware evidence and adds management-continuity safeguards specific to a BMC-card query.
independent_technical_reasoning: This record is uniquely sensitive because the target component also hosts the management channel used to query it. Text matching cannot prove that the returned CARD object belongs to the active BMC, and the supplied regex is technically wrong. A safe review first establishes removable-card versus onboard architecture, then maps a stable FRU ID and compares full hardware fields while an independent recovery route remains available. That makes evidence collection automatable but still requires owner confirmation.
